svg.text: InfluenceLab | follow the deletion, do not freeze the derivative
Selected sample weights follow 1-t. At each node: a converged refit and a new implicit derivative.
Numerical endpoint refits, not symbolic arithmetic. All changes concern the same supplied query loss.
The query-loss derivative changes along the path
Quadrature gaps remain visible: Simpson estimate minus actual endpoint loss change
Group deletion is not a sum of separately refitted deletions
delete [5,6] -0.357507 vs sum of individual deletions -0.142898
Deleting all rows even reverses the sign of the frozen first-order prediction on this developed fixture.
51 path fits, 3 groups x 17 nodes. Coarse quadrature levels reuse the fine-grid fits.
Fixed original-N normalization and ridge0.1. No damping, warm starts, causal claim or numerical error certification.
Numerical path sensitivity is not machine unlearning, a scalable deletion algorithm or a guarantee about other datasets.
